headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red after CAS while Nifty gained 75 points; smallcaps showed resilience.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following CAS while the Nifty 50 managed a 75-point gain.
Small-cap stocks provided support to the broader market despite volatility in front-line indices.
Investors reacted to mixed global cues and prepared for potential disruptions in the coming week.
Profit booking was observed in Sensex heavyweights while certain Nifty components maintained upward momentum.
whatHappening: Nifty 50 gained 75 points while the Sensex ended the session in the red after CAS.
Small-cap stocks showed resilience and outperformed the main indices during the last trading session.
Geopolitical tensions rose as Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities, impacting energy sector outlook.
The Finance Ministry prepared for a meeting with bank chiefs regarding an upcoming three-day strike.
summary:
On the last trading day, the Sensex slipped into the red while the Nifty 50 gained 75 points.
Current news focuses on geopolitical tensions in Riyadh, upcoming bank strikes, and India's semiconductor ecosystem security.
The market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, September 21, 2026.
